title: 机场值机 · 托运超重
intro: 值机柜台最常听到的十句话。重点练数字、行李和登机口信息。

sentences.en: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket, please?
sentences.zh: 早上好，请出示您的护照和机票。

sentences.en: Here you are. I'd like to check in for the flight to London.
sentences.zh: 给你。我想办理去伦敦的航班值机。
sentences.tip: I'd like to 读成 /aɪd laɪk tə/，d 和 t 都轻。

sentences.en: Certainly. Are you checking any bags today?
sentences.zh: 好的。今天有行李要托运吗？

sentences.en: Just this one, and I'll keep the small bag with me.
sentences.zh: 就这一件，小包我随身带着。

sentences.en: Please put it on the scale. It's two kilos over the limit.
sentences.zh: 请放上传送带。超重两公斤。

sentences.en: Oh, how much would the extra charge be?
That'll be thirty pounds, or you can move some items to your carry-on.
sentences.zh: 三十英镑；或者您可以把一些东西挪到随身行李里。

sentences.en: I'll move a few things instead. Thanks for the tip.
sentences.zh: 那我还是拿点东西出来吧，谢谢提醒。

sentences.en: No problem. Here's your boarding pass. Gate twenty-two, boarding at ten forty.
sentences.zh: 没问题。这是登机牌。22 号登机口，十点四十登机。

sentences.en: Great, thank you. Have a nice day.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢，祝你今天愉快。
